Definition: asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun)
BiblicalUsage: Pitch is the word's plain meaning, and its two appearances could hardly differ more. Moses' mother coats his little basket with it to keep the water out, and Isaiah sees the streams of Edom turned to burning pitch in judgment. The same black tar saves a baby and seals a ruin.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's care shows in small things: a mother's pitch on a basket is as much His providence as any deliverance.
